headings.text: Appendix A Additional Details of the Experimental Setup

core.text: ACL are early efforts that focus primarily on zero-shot quantization (e.g., FP4), where quantization can be performed without model-specific optimization. Whether such methods can be extended to more complex, optimization-based quantization techniques, such as GGUF quantization, remains an open question. Likewise, in the context of ACL-enhanced LLM quantization attacks, the design of more effective defense mechanisms is still underexplored. Furthermore, due to the computationally intensive nature of adversarial training and text generation, the hyperparameters used in our experiments may not be optimal. We hope that future work can address these open questions and further improve the safety of LLMs for real-world deployment and applications.
